subject: Unplanned ingest spike — evidence & collection path
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@greenframe.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenframe Billing <billing@greenframe.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected 6/13–6/14 token surge — please hold invoice

Sergio —

We just received an alert that our June 13–14 usage shows a ~14x jump versus our baseline and the invoice preview reflects a large overage. We ran a quick check on our side and we do not see any traffic that should account for this. Can you please:

- Pause any collection actions and hold the June invoice while you investigate.
- Provide the raw usage export (per-request) for 2027-06-13 UTC 00:00–23:59 and any sampling logs.
- Confirm whether this is attributable to prefetching/ingest replay or something on Redwood's side.

I attached a screenshot of our billing alert. We need a response today — our finance team is waiting to know if we should earmark funds.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Ops Lead, Greenframe
(attachment: greenframe_usage_snapshot.pdf)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@greenframe.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 6/13–6/14 token surge — please hold invoice

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and the attachment. I've put a hold on collection for Greenframe's June invoice (billing team notified). Ben, can you pull the per-request export ASAP and look for anomalies (duplicate request IDs / orphaned replay jobs)? Grace, I'll sync with you on the account messaging so we align with the CS playbook.

Elena — we'll aim to get a preliminary export and root-cause summary within 24 hours. If this looks like a platform-side duplication we will propose a provisional credit and route for VAT treatment if applicable.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 6/13–6/14 token surge — please hold invoice

Folks —

I pulled the 2027-06-13 per-request export and a sampling of the raw ingress logs. High-level findings:

- There is a concentrated burst between 2027-06-13T04:52:00Z and 2027-06-13T05:18:00Z showing ~11M extra tokens.
- Many requests in that window have identical request_id prefixes and nearly identical prompt hashes — looks like a replay / batch resubmission rather than distinct user traffic.
- Upstream we see a spike in our prefetch worker queue that coincides with an Autoscale event in the customer's dedicated pool (possible correlation).

I'm attaching the per-request CSV export (usage-20270613-export.csv) and a short provisional credit worksheet. I'm tagging Marissa because if we recommend a provisional credit we need finance approval for the amount and VAT handling.

Next steps I propose: create a root-cause ticket with infra (logs + kernel traces), request the customer's replay job ids (if any), and prepare a provisional credit for the spike window while we finish the RCA.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations
(attachment: usage-20270613-export.csv; provisional-credit-worksheet.xlsx)

From: Elena Soto <elena@greenframe.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: Greenframe Billing <billing@greenframe.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected 6/13–6/14 token surge — please hold invoice

Thanks Ben — that's helpful. A couple of clarifying items from our side:

- We do have a nightly reindexing job but it runs at 02:00 UTC and is limited to our staging namespace; it should not generate production requests.
- We will pull job traces on our side and forward any matching request ids tonight.

Urgent asks:
- Can Redwood confirm whether provisional credits will be applied to the June invoice before it is finalized? Our AP team needs to know whether to block payment processing.
- If a credit is issued, how will VAT be handled? Will you issue a credit note or a separate zeroing invoice?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please keep the hold in place until we agree on a remediation path.

Elena

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Greenframe spike — proposed provisional credit and VAT pathing

Grace/Marissa —

Summary: Billing ops (Ben) found a concentrated replay-like burst on 2027-06-13 (04:52–05:18Z) representing ~11M incremental tokens. Customer claims no production job at that window. Customer is asking for invoice hold and VAT guidance.

Recommendation:
- Apply a provisional credit covering the spike window (see worksheet attached) to avoid collection while we finish RCA.
- For VAT: if credit is processed before invoice finalization, issue a credit note referencing invoice preview and tag as 'provisional correction' — finance should confirm whether to zero the line or issue a separate corrective invoice.
- Ask infra to preserve kernel and worker traces for 30 days and create a postmortem with customer once we confirm root cause.

Please advise if finance can approve a provisional credit up to $6,200 (estimate) pending final RCA. I've created ticket https://hub.redwood.ai/tickets/GF-3482 and uploaded raw exports to s3://redwood-exports/greenframe/2027-06-13/usage-raw.csv.

If approved I'll notify Elena and confirm collection remains on hold.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
